initiative.title: PGM local viewer
initiative.summary: Include the existing editable viewer in pgm with project data and images stored locally.
initiative.next_action: Resolve managed local runtime versus server-free CLI commands, then write the implementation plan.

sources.anchor: pgm executable include the viewer; EXACT SAME viewer; on disk updates; images stored on disk
main resolves server/token/project then constructs ProductGridClient
files excludes app output; pgm bin; Node >=22
serializeProjectRecord persists operationLog; parseStoredProjectRecord reconstructs state
Configuring Nitro; Node preset; server functions

claims.statement: Installed pgm includes the complete existing viewer.
Viewer edits persist to local disk; image bytes are local too.
Keep local operation as a separate mode alongside remote server access.
Must CLI commands operate without any local server process?
claims.notes: Asked asynchronously. No answer has been received. Managed local runtime is an agent recommendation.

claims.statement: CLI and viewer should share one write authority and retain current event behavior.

human_questions.question: Can pgm manage a local server, or must CLI commands work directly on files with no server?
human_questions.impact: Changes service extraction and cross-process coordination needs.

shape.appetite: Reuse the current app and disk format. Limit new work to packaging, startup, and explicit local targeting.
shape.problem: Local use currently requires a separately running app service.

recommended_shape.description: Bundle the complete app output with pgm and run it on loopback with an explicit APP_DATA_DIR. Route local CLI and browser operations through that process.

success_moves: Keep CLI and viewer mutations in one process.
Ship server output and browser assets together from the same build.
Resolve an explicit absolute data folder outside installed code.
Prove production auth, images, persistence, and events against disposable data.

first_proof.question: Can this app's current production output run from a relocated artifact without checkout dependencies?
first_proof.artifact: A fresh app build copied under tmp and started with a disposable APP_DATA_DIR, loopback host, and local API token.
first_proof.decision_rule: Accept bundling if project create/edit, asset resolution, image round-trip, and restart persistence work without checkout files. Otherwise correct output packaging before launcher work.

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Existing edits in three spatial-map components and untracked .tickets are unrelated and preserved. Branch codex/grid-local-ready.
test_commands: pnpm --dir app exec vitest run src/lib/projects/data.server.test.ts
repository_snapshot.data_target: app/data contains user projects. Port 3000 is identified as user server in existing tickets. Do not use either for write proofs.
repository_snapshot.output_observation: Existing .output has node-server metadata dated 2026-10-01. It is not verified against current source or proven relocatable.

dependencies.name: SolidStart/Vinxi/Nitro packaged runtime
dependencies.application_seam: Complete app build launched by pgm with process environment and existing HTTP routes.

first_proof_role.rationale: A fake cannot establish asset closure, server action routing, or output relocation.

dependencies.local_proof: Fresh build with root base path, disposable data, loopback host, and real HTTP calls. Verify current installed runtime behavior; newer docs are not an exact-version guarantee.
dependencies.live_proof: No cloud proof needed. Install a locally packed artifact outside the checkout. Publication is not authorized.
dependencies.rollout: Add explicit local selection; preserve existing remote selection without automatic fallback.

dependencies.name: Local filesystem and single writer
dependencies.application_seam: APP_DATA_DIR and current projects disk services.

first_proof_role.rationale: Disk persistence and image bytes are the requested behavior; disposable real files are cheaper and more faithful than a fake.

dependencies.local_proof: Use a new tmp data root, check saved records and image bytes, restart, and verify concurrent CLI requests preserve changes. Never use app/data.
dependencies.live_proof: No shared infrastructure or production data required.
dependencies.rollout: User selects local folder explicitly. Installed package files never contain mutable user data.

fast_local_loop.command: pnpm --dir app build, then launch relocated output with disposable APP_DATA_DIR and loopback host
fast_local_loop.network: Loopback only after dependencies are installed. Disable CLI update checks through PGM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 for offline proofs.

history.reason: User requested design exploration for pgm local viewer.
Current app already has disk persistence. Packaging and local runtime reuse are the smallest credible approach. Runtime boundary remains a human decision; detailed plan is deferred.
